target.title: fix(desktop): use native system notifications
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Tauri desktop companion rendered approval and update alerts through a generic desktop notification path. On macOS that looked like a fake app window instead of a real Notification Center alert.

## Why This Change Was Made

The companion now uses `tauri-plugin-notifications` from current upstream `main`, pinned to an immutable commit:

- macOS uses Swift `UNUserNotificationCenter`.
- Windows uses `notify-rust`'s WinRT system-toast adapter. Source builds omit the installed app identifier, while installed builds use OpenClaw's identifier.
- Linux keeps its existing `notify-rust` desktop notification service.

The dependency pin includes upstream `main` after 0.5.0-rc.11 plus the focused Swift 6.4 release-linking repair proposed in [upstream PR #269](https://github.com/Choochmeque/tauri-plugin-notifications/pull/269). The OpenClaw pin can return to upstream after that repair lands.

Unbundled macOS development binaries skip plugin initialization because Apple's notification framework requires a real app-bundle identity. Signed `.app` bundles retain the normal permission request and notification flow.

Compatibility decision: the macOS deployment minimum moves from 10.13 to 13.0 because macOS 13 is the upstream plugin's supported Swift package contract. We intentionally use that maintained contract instead of carrying an unsupported lower-deployment fork.

## User Impact

macOS alerts now appear as native Notification Center notifications. Windows uses native system toasts. Linux behavior stays unchanged.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the implementation, dependency source, and platform behavior.

## Evidence

- macOS: optimized Developer ID-signed `.app` built successfully with Swift 6.4; signature and exact dependency linkage verified. A real OpenClaw approval notification was observed in Notification Center through the production notification path.
- Windows Server 2022 / MSVC at exact PR head: feature graph selected `notify-rust`/WinRT; all 34 unit tests passed; optimized executable built at 16,093,696 bytes; native NSIS installer built at 3,716,021 bytes.
- Linux: optimized deb and AppImage bundles built successfully on Ubuntu 22.04 in [exact-head hosted proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29574353953).
- Full exact-head hosted checks: 69 successful, 0 failed in [CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29574353924).
- macOS Rust proof: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo check --locked`, and all 34 unit tests passed.
- Target feature graphs verified that macOS excludes `notify-rust`, while Windows and Linux select it.
- Fresh autoreview: clean, no accepted or actionable findings.

Root `CHANGELOG.md` is release-owned; release-note context is recorded here.
